newsitem.title: USA: Men's Wearhouse names Edwab pres, Lane COO.
newsitem.headline: Men's Wearhouse names Edwab pres, Lane COO.

text.p: Men's Wearhouse Inc Monday said it named David Edwab, the company's chief operating and financial officer, as president.
George Zimmer, the company's founder who formerly held the title of president, will continue to serve as chairman of the board and chief executive officer.
Replacing Edwab as chief operating officer is Eric Lane, who has served as the company's senior vice president of merchandising since 1993.

Founded in 1973, the Men's Wearhouse is one of the country's largest off-price specialty retailers of men's tailored business attire. The company currently operates 330 the Men's Wearhouse stores in 33 states. In addition, the company operates 17 C&R Clothier stores in southern California, which it acquired in January, 1997.
